backbone.construction: construct one public pure-LinearNO backbone and capture its state_dict by key
backbone.copy_rule: copy identical backbone keys to A0K0/A1K0/A0K1/A1K1; no reconstruction per combination
backbone.constructor_order: innovation modules cannot consume RNG before public backbone initialization
backbone.backbone_initialization_scope: existing LinearNO constructor and its documented outer initialization only

innovation.independence: does not advance public backbone RNG

dataloader.generator: independent torch.Generator per task and split

comparison.baseline_to_research: init_from_baseline only in a future explicitly authorized protocol; never resume
